title: Repair Estimates & Appointments Desk Reference Card: Insurer Direct Teardown Payments
content:
## Situation

On a Repair Estimates & Appointments insurance-claim booking of an estimate type that allows insurer direct billing, the insurer pays its teardown allowance toward the teardown charge directly, as one insurer direct payment on that charge, and the owner answers for any part of the teardown charge above it.

The insurer's direct payment toward a teardown charge is fixed only after the teardown charge for the teardown performed stands on the booking. The insurer's direct payment toward a teardown charge is not worked out until the booking carries a measurement charge for every structural measurement report produced on it.

## How it is invoked

The remittance is the insurer's own act. The desk unlocks the customer-side tool `remit_insurer_direct_payment_12af7a63` and hands it over to the customer themselves — here the insurer on the booking, acting through its own account profile — who runs it; the desk gives the insurer the booking and charge reference numbers to quote. The tool itself checks no policy condition.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `booking_id` | Reference number of the policyholder's estimate booking, as given to the insurer by the desk from the estimate booking lookup | Id |
| `charge_event_id` | Reference number of the charge the insurer pays, as given to the insurer by the desk from the booking history or a posting receipt | Id |
| `amount_usd` | Amount the insurer remits toward that charge | USD with 2 decimal places, positive; a value with more decimals is rounded half-up to the cent when stored |

## Return

The payment is recorded as an insurer direct payment on that charge, dated today, and lowers the charge's outstanding amount by the sum remitted. The confirmation names the new payment reference number (an id beginning with "eev"), the charge reference number paid and the amount remitted in USD with 2 decimals; seeing that reference number means the insurer's direct payment was applied. The insurer receives the payment reference number for its file.
